evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No historical reference has been established; observations begin at contract activation.
evidenceCoverage.reason: Prospective goal contract without an established historical reference.

caveat: The evidence measures repository outcomes against a frozen goal, not the causal impact of an agent or contract activation.

intent.goal: Compiler errors that help developers actually correct syntax.
intent.acceptance: For native numeric-engine mutation opportunities, independently verify the exact file, line and engine-key or invalid-value token location, and an explicit repair restoring the native-accepted original. These are partial facets, not measured developer usability.

evaluation.reason: Current-source-only reconstruction. This is not workflow adoption; historical source profiles and original native diagnostic/input receipts are not acquired. Earlier evidence has not been exhausted.

evidence.opportunity: One distinct full document accepted by the pinned compiler, mutated only from a scalar built-in engine name to a numeric engine value, with original native validation JSON retained for both inputs.
filters: Exact repository ID 1036865607 and compiler revision c86377ec47b38f0b5af463277ee55d1d03d08da8.
Numeric-engine facet only; exactly one parse_error; no shared/redirect skip, ambiguous aliases, duplicate engine, multiline edits or inferred compiler results.
Native case completion in inclusive windowStart/exclusive windowEnd; never use acquisition timestamps as historical execution dates.
Actor independent. Agent scores, issue creation, closure, merges and editable tracking markers are not acceptance.
evidence.collection: Offline, digest-checked original input and native gh aw compile --json outputs. Read the shared source archive once per batch. No API calls, code execution, inferred historical predicates, or reconstructed diagnostic prose.
evidence.authority: The archive is a preserved-evidence boundary, not cryptographic proof of who ran a compiler. Original native producer custody must be established separately; checksum integrity alone does not establish authenticity.

model.architecture: Fixed native partial facets; independent source mutation oracle and original compiler-result decoder.
model.recommendation: Report unavailable until original inputs and compiler receipts exist; do not interpret partial facets as full usability or delivered improvement.

limitations: This deliberately narrow oracle does not cover all YAML/configuration errors, clarity, examples, consistency, developer task success, time-to-repair or regression safety.
Missing original observations are null, not zero. Unassessed cases block a complete cohort; observed partial native subtotals remain visible.
Full usability needs independent developer correction-task evidence with original diagnostic exposure and accepted repaired input; the workflow's subjective dimensions are rejected.

Workflow-linked delivered improvement needs original safe-output/run identity, accepted issue-to-PR graph, immutable merge/parent changes and paired native before/after diagnostic evidence on the same cases. None is inferred from the discovery inventory.
Delivery, if later supported, belongs in separate disjoint merge-time cohorts, never rolling diagnostic snapshots or sums of overlapping periods.
Current source predicates are not applied to earlier revisions. A reviewed new profile is required for any historical backfill or later compiler revision.
